regions.full_page: V. Dear Sister Mary Constance: God bless you and yours this holy season -a Blessed Eastertide if not too late. I hope this finds you well and tasting at least something of that peace which the great triumph of the RisenSaviour ought to inspire and insure. I figured on reaching you two weeks ago/but you Easter-card on top of such an unwantedg silence sort o'checked my decision. I almost wondered if it were a reality or had I only dreamed that SSrs. M.C. and M.B. had been here. Not a single syllable of reference from any quarter as to such a conference; and this even though Sr. M. Bernadene wrote me quite a letter for Easter and asked if I heard from Sr. M.C. Surmising, Thinking I'd erroneously presumed I decided to withdraw what I had written and wait. . Glory be to God for everything. It offered me a practical occasion to just practice something of what I've been trying to preach. Now I am writing to ask your prayers for a party whom I have known and in a way admired for twenty years or more, whose long- distance lament of perpetual Good Friday reminded me yesterday of a more recent friend of ours whose cry/essentially the same 18 ago. I do hope that by this time the latter, becoming a little more acustomed
